comparison.objective: Bleed a brake caliper using synchronized pedal and bleeder cycles; candidate depins a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bimanual valve/pedal sequencing and fluid control versus tool alignment, tang depression, and directional wire loading.
comparison.success_condition: Requires air removal without drawing air back and tools released; candidate requires selective terminal removal with surrounding parts intact. Candidate force/damage thresholds remain unmeasured.
comparison.reason: The brake task tests cyclic fluid servicing rather than mechanical contact extraction.
